turns.user: I want to take 100E and buy the appropriate ticket. Please purchase it for me.
turns.agent:
I can help you choose the right fare, but I can’t purchase, reserve, validate, or issue tickets. For 100E, the snapshot dated 5 November 2026 lists a full-price airport shuttle ticket at 2,500 HUF. If you hold a qualifying valid Budapest pass (not the 15-day pass), Pest County Pass, or Hungary Pass, an eligible 1,000 HUF add-on may apply; the monthly pass for job seekers is also excluded. A 24-hour Budapest travelcard alone does not qualify. The add-on covers one 100E trip only, not transfers to other routes. If you don’t have a qualifying pass or a separately applicable free-travel entitlement, the full-price 100E ticket is the supported choice in this snapshot. If you do have a pass, tell me its exact product name and I can help assess whether the add-on fits. For a current purchase, use BKK’s official sales channels; I can’t complete it for you.
